instruction: Não usar estes resultados como pendência ou bloqueio do Discovery. Aplicar a orientação vigente determinada pelo usuário.

execution_record.scope: Accuracy of post-content evidence and package, before canonical receipt persistence. Known RG procedural failure retained; no new authority.
execution_record.source_authorship: Coordinator authored receipts/package/finalizer; auditor wrote only AUDITORIA-SUPLEMENTO.md and ACHADOS-SUPLEMENTO.json

package.metadata: 1980 timestamp, Unix100644, ZIP_STORED, Windows pathlib.Path ordering

diagnostic.initial_check: ZIP_NAMES because audit assumed POSIX string ordering
diagnostic.recheck: Actual ordering exactly matches sorted Windows PureWindowsPath; no collisions. Source generator fixes that ordering and two emitted ZIP bytes match.
diagnostic.disposition: Not package defect; deterministic in observed environment, no cross-platform identity claim.

findings.source: RG-TENTATIVA-1.md consultation section; RG-TENTATIVA-2.md §7 items5–7; DIARIO connector_route_observations
findings.observed: For exact D02 branch resolution, RG1 used encoded branch GET400 then successful ref alternative. RG2 repeated the failed encoded route after the initial-plus-alternative allowance had been consumed. Shared exhaustion was not propagated. Changing agent/context did not reset it.
findings.counter_scope: D02 route alone suffices; no need to combine earlier D01 baseline object to establish breach.
findings.impact: RG procedure FAIL despite 11/11 positive semantic criteria. Prior A/content/G/F evidence remains valid in its own earlier scope.
findings.correction_of_claim: Coordinator withdrew RG PASS, preserved initial evaluation as historical_only, corrected continuity/journal/report/vector to RG FAIL and COM_FALHAS.
findings.remediation: No third recovery attempt or repeat of exhausted route; occurrence cannot be remediated retrospectively. Persist accurate failure and limits. Future genuinely new scope cannot be a renamed retry.

semantic_recovery.source_review: Read complete RG2 report and initial/follow-up messages; each AX and HUM03/06 conditions/negatives present; this is distinct from failed procedural gate.

execution_record.Z_reason: Canonical receipt commit and immutable reread not yet observed at this cut; later proof may set Z PASS while global remains COM_FALHAS.
limitations: Auditor did not author/edit content, receipts, package or finalizer and performed no external mutation.
Coordinator base64 readbacks recorded; auditor independently queried commit/tree/PR/CI and matched every selected cache blob and original to that remote tree, plus local ZIP payload/manifest.
No human signature or corporate identity authenticated by hashes. Native Sources/Instructions inaccessible; project metadata inventory does not prove native content.

Late finalizer is scoped to the inspected source/output directories; it is not a general security-hardened packaging tool. Current v1/v2 contain no symlinks and all source originals match authenticated objects.
Evidence persistence must retain RG failure; later Z PASS does not fix RG or authorize another attempt.
